mentions.context_excerpt: At CES in January, NVIDIA announced several models released with NVFP4 and FP8 support. And now more NVFP4 and FP8 models are available — LTX-2.3, with NVFP4 support coming soon, FLUX.2 Klein 4B , and FLUX.2 Klein 9B — directly in ComfyUI. To get started, download the NVFP4 and FP8 checkpoints directly from Hugging Face, load the default workflows in ComfyUI via the Template Browser and replace the default model checkpoint with the newly downloaded checkpoint.

mentions.context_excerpt: For AI developers, NVIDIA released a free Python package available via the PyPI repository , along with sample code on GitHub and a VFX Python bindings guide , to get started quickly. The package provides programmatic access to the same AI upscaling technology that powers RTX Video, running directly on RTX GPU Tensor Cores to deliver 4K upscaling 30x faster than alternative popular local upscalers, and at a fraction of the VRAM cost. The package is powered by the NVIDIA Video Effects software development kit .
